parsed.reason: The acknowledgment mirrors the parent's words back almost verbatim ("Zoé is 5 and André is 7 - got them both"), which feels like a database echo rather than a natural human reply. A warmer, plain-spoken version would simply confirm the two children without parroting the exact phrasing. It's faithful to the facts and adds nothing invented, but the mechanical repetition of the parent's own sentence lowers the voice quality noticeably.
